sentences.text:
This petition has been filed by the petitioners seeking restraint on the respondents from acquiring the land of the petitioners other than in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short 'the Act, 2013').
2. Submissions have been made that the respondents are offering a paltry compensation for the purpose of executing the sale deed in respect of land in favour of the State and without following the Kamleshwar Singh And 12 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64116251/
1 procedure as prescribed under the Act of 2013, the land is sought to be acquired.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel submits that the respondents would not take possession of the land of the petitioners unless the petitioners execute sale deeds in favour of the State.
He further submits that in case the parties fail to arrive at a mutual consensus, the respondents will resort to compulsory acquisition.

4. In view of the above, the petition is disposed of by providing that the respondents would not compel the petitioners to execute sale deeds in respect of their land unless the parties arrive at an amicable settlement in relation to the amount of sale consideration.
In the event, the parties fail to arrive at mutual consensus, it would be open for the respondents to avail the procedure prescribed under law for compulsory acquisition.
